props.name: words
props.description: The words to cycle through, in order. The first one is what reduced motion shows.

props.name: interval
props.description: Milliseconds each word rests before morphing into the next.

props.name: accessibleText
props.description: What assistive tech reads in place of the animation: every word as one list, or only the first. It is read once, where it sits, and never repeated.

props.name: announce
props.description: Also announce each new word through a polite live region. Off by default, because a phrase that talks every two seconds is noise.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged last, so it wins. Size and weight come from here or the surrounding text.
